# Muster — Full Reference for LLMs and AI Tools

> Muster (`oliveralerubio/muster`, Apache-2.0, Rust) syncs AI coding agent configurations, Agent Skills, subagents, MCP servers, AI provider endpoints, and age-encrypted secrets across machines and teams from a single Git repository — local-first, with zero telemetry and no third-party servers.

---

## 1. What Problem Muster Solves

Developers using AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, Pi, Hermes Agent) across multiple machines (laptop, workstation, remote Linux box, or team) face three recurring problems:
1. **Configuration drift:** Instructions (`CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`), MCP server definitions, permissions, hooks, custom subagents, and Agent Skills live in incompatible per-agent paths and formats (Markdown, JSON, TOML, YAML).
2. **Insecure secret sharing:** API keys and tokens for MCP servers or AI providers often end up duplicated in plaintext dotfiles or passed into LLM conversation transcripts.
3. **Unverified skill & binary sprawl:** Skills installed ad-hoc have no integrity pinning or cross-machine sync.

Muster solves all three with one canonical Git repository (`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/muster` by default), rendering native config files losslessly per adapter while encrypting secrets per machine with `age` and gating agent access deny-by-default.

---

## 2. Installation & Platforms

**Supported platforms:** Linux, WSL2, and macOS (`x86_64` and `aarch64`). Native Windows is not supported.
**Runtime dependency:** `git` only (`curl` or `wget` needed only for the install script or pinned agent binary downloads).

**Option 1 — Release binary installer:**
```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oliveralerubio/muster/main/install.sh | bash
```
- Detects OS/architecture, downloads `muster-<tag>-<target>.tar.gz`, verifies SHA-256 against `SHA256SUMS`, and installs to `~/.local/bin/muster`.
- Optional environment variables: `MUSTER_VERSION` (e.g. `v0.1.0`), `MUSTER_INSTALL_DIR`, `MUSTER_REPO`.

**Option 2 — Build from source with Cargo:**
```sh
git clone https://github.com/oliveralerubio/muster
cd muster
cargo install --path .
```

---

## 3. Supported Agent Adapters & Native Paths

Stable adapters (enabled by default unless `[agents].enabled` restricts them):

| Agent | ID | Binary | Capabilities | User Skills | Project Skills | User Subagents |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | `claude` | `claude` | instructions, MCP (stdio + remote), models, permissions, hooks, skills, subagents, providers (`api_key_helper`) | `~/.claude/skills/<skill>/` | `.claude/skills/<skill>/` | `~/.claude/agents/<name>.md` |
| Codex | `codex` | `codex` | instructions, MCP (stdio + remote), models, skills, subagents (TOML), providers | `~/.agents/skills/<skill>/` | `.agents/skills/<skill>/` | `~/.codex/agents/<name>.toml` |
| OpenCode | `opencode` | `opencode` | instructions, MCP (stdio + remote), models, skills, subagents, providers | `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode/skills/<skill>/` | `.opencode/skills/<skill>/` | `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode/agents/<name>.md` |
| Antigravity CLI | `antigravity` | `agy` | instructions, MCP (stdio + remote), skills, subagents | `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills/<skill>/` | `.agents/skills/<skill>/` | `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/agents/<name>.md` |
| Pi | `pi` | `pi` | instructions, MCP (stdio + remote), models, skills, subagents, packages | `~/.pi/agent/skills/<skill>/` | `.pi/skills/<skill>/` | `~/.pi/agent/agents/<name>.md` |

Experimental adapter (opt-in via `[agents].enabled`):
- **Hermes Agent** (`hermes`, binary `hermes`): instructions (`~/.hermes/SOUL.md` / project `AGENTS.md`), MCP (stdio + remote), models (`~/.hermes/config.yaml`), skills (`~/.hermes/skills/`).

Lossless merging rules:
- Markdown instruction files use `BEGIN/END MUSTER MANAGED BLOCK` delimiters so hand-written content outside the block is preserved.
- JSON/TOML/YAML configs update only keys Muster manages, leaving personal settings untouched.
- Agent-specific instruction overlays (`AGENTS.<agent-id>.md`) extend canonical `AGENTS.md` per adapter.
- Per-layer toggles (`[agents.toggles]` with `enable`/`disable` for `skill:<name>`, `mcp:<name>@<adapter>`, `subagent:<name>`) evaluate in fixed precedence: `team -> group -> member -> machine -> project`.

---

## 4. Core Workflows

### 4.1 First machine setup & multi-machine sync
```sh
muster init                              # Create config repo, machine age identity, recovery key, empty vault
muster agents apply                      # Render native config for enabled adapters
muster sync --remote <git-url>           # Push config repo to your private Git remote
muster ui                                # Launch localhost web admin (127.0.0.1, one-time token)
```
Enroll a second machine via SSH in one command:
```sh
muster machine add <ssh-host> [--name <alias>] [--profile <profile>]
```
Or from the second machine directly:
```sh
muster sync --remote <git-url> --pull
muster enroll
# Approve on an existing admin machine:
muster approve <machine-name>
# Pull & apply on the new machine:
muster sync
```
Scheduled background sync (`systemd` user timer on Linux/WSL2, `launchd` on macOS):
```sh
muster schedule enable [--pull]
```

### 4.2 Agent Skills & Subagents lifecycle
- **Own skills:** `muster skill add <name> --description "..."` creates `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` and pins its SHA-256 hash in `skills.lock`.
- **Subscribed external skills:** `muster skill add --url <git-url> [--ref <ref>] [--path <dir>] [--include <skill>]` vendors skills into `skills/` and records upstream commit + `content_hash` in `skills.lock`.
- **Import existing unmanaged skills:** `muster skill import --all` brings hand-installed or `npx skills`-installed skills under Muster management (linking upstream repos from `~/.agents/.skill-lock.json` when present).
- **Check & update:** `muster skill check`, `muster skill update [name] [--all]`, or opt-in `muster skill auto-update on`.
- **Inspect & prune:** `muster effective`, `muster why <text>`, and `muster usage --since 14d` (analyzes local transcripts without network access to report unused skills/MCPs/subagents).

### 4.3 Secrets, Vault, Graphical Capture & Blind Execution
- **age vault:** Each secret group is stored as an `age`-encrypted ciphertext in the Git repo with plaintext metadata sidecars (never values). Each machine has its own private key; an offline recovery key is shown once at `muster init`.
- **Deny-by-default access:** Secrets are only materialized into an agent's MCP config or revealed via `muster mcp` when `[secrets."native://<group>/<name>"]` explicitly lists that agent in `allow` (e.g. `allow = ["claude", "codex@my-repo"]`).
- **Runtime approval leases:** Setting `approval = "each"` and `approval_ttl = "15m"` requires explicit human approval (`muster secret approve <id>` in a real terminal or authenticated Web UI) before `secret.get --reveal`, `secret.run`, or MCP `secret_reveal` succeeds.
- **Out-of-band GUI capture (never paste secrets in agent chat):**
  ```sh
  muster secret prompt <group>/<name> --reason "API key for Postgres MCP" --allow claude --format json
  ```
  Opens native GUI askpass/osascript/zenity/kdialog/pinentry or an ephemeral localhost browser dialog (`127.0.0.1:0`) with `HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict` cookies and CSRF protection; never writes plaintext secrets to stdout, stderr, or transcripts.
- **Blind subprocess execution with output scrubbing:**
  ```sh
  muster secret run --agent claude --env API_KEY=native://prod/api_key --yes -- <command> [args...]
  ```
  Injects secrets only via child env or stdin (never argv), blocks dangerous env vars (`PATH`, `LD_*`, `DYLD_*`, `MUSTER_*`), and scrubs raw, JSON/TOML/shell-escaped, URL-encoded, and Base64-encoded secret occurrences from stdout/stderr.

### 4.4 AI Providers
Declare endpoints once in `[providers.<id>]` (`openai`, `openai-compatible`, `anthropic`, `google`, `ollama`) with optional `base_url`, `default_model`, and `key = "native://..."` or `env://...`, then bind per agent via `muster provider use <id> --agent <agent>`. Subscription logins stay local per machine via `muster provider login claude|codex` (Muster never copies OAuth tokens).

### 4.5 Team Mode & Cryptographic Fleet Governance
Team mode activates when `[members]` is non-empty (`muster member add`). Supports `admin` and `member` roles, secret groups (`muster group create/grant/revoke/rekey`), configurable multi-admin approval quorums (`[team] required_approvals`), and Ed25519 signed fleet state (`muster trust show/resign/cosign/checkpoint`) protecting against unauthorized manifest or key-injection tampering in Git remotes.

---

## 5. CLI Contract & MCP Server (`muster mcp`)

- Every CLI command supports `--format json`, `--dry-run`, and `--yes`, returning a single JSON envelope:
  ```json
  { "schema_version": 1, "command": "...", "ok": true, "result": { ... }, "diagnostics": [] }
  ```
- Deterministic exit codes: `0` success, `1` operational failure, `2` usage/TTY confirmation required, `3` invalid config, `4` dependency unavailable, `5` security/authorization denial, `130` interrupted.
- Run `muster schema --format json` to inspect the full machine-readable command & parameter registry.
- `muster mcp` runs a newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 server over stdio exposing read-only inspection tools (`status`, `doctor`, `plan`, `effective`, `why`, `usage`, `provider_list`, `secret_list_meta`), proposal-gated mutation (`propose_change`, which stages edits into `proposals/<id>/` for human `muster proposal accept`), and allowlisted `secret_reveal`.

---

## 6. Comparisons (Muster vs. Alternatives)

- **vs. chezmoi / GNU stow / dotbot:** Generic dotfile managers treat files as raw templates or symlinks. Muster understands native schemas for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, Pi, and Hermes; performs key-level/block-level lossless merges; verifies vendored Agent Skills via `skills.lock` SHA-256 hashes; translates subagents across Markdown/TOML; and enforces per-agent secret `allow` policies.
- **vs. 1Password CLI / Bitwarden:** Cloud secret managers require third-party servers/accounts and lack native awareness of AI agent config files, MCP `allow` gating, `propose_change` workflows, or output-scrubbed `secret run`. Muster stores secrets in a local-first Git + `age` vault under your exclusive control (and also supports `muster import bws` / `chezmoi` / `cuartel`).
